title: Be Free and Stay Free
verse: She replied, “No one, Lord.” And Jesus said, “I do not condemn you either. Go, and from now on do not sin any more.”]]
observation: Jesus is just awesome. He knew what to do and realized that everyone in that crowd was just as guilty as that lady. True, they had not been caught in the act of adultery, but they still were guilty of sin. This does not mean we cannot notice when someone else has sinned. We just do not become their executioner. We leave that to the Lord. I love how He set her free, but told her it was up to her to stay free. God will walk with her every step, but we must realize that freedom takes focus. We stay free by staying close to the Lord.
application: Be free and stay free by staying close to the Lord today.
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for setting us free from all the sin we are willing to bring to You.
